Hi Sarah — thanks for reaching out and for the sample invoice. Happy to outline our preferred onboarding and invoice routing so your AP team can pick the smoothest path. Notes below.

1) Vendor onboarding / portal (preferred)- URL: https://redwood.example.com/vendor-onboarding/form/8921- What we need to create the portal account: W-9 (US vendors) or equivalent tax form, remit address, vendor contact, and bank remit instructions if you want ACH.- PO matching: Once set up we will create a PO per contract or per-work order; invoices should include the PO number in the invoice header so they auto-match in our AP system.- File naming: Prefer {VendorName}_Invoice_{InvoiceNumber}.pdf (e.g., Acme_Invoice_000123.pdf).

2) Email submission (fallback / temporary)- Send to: finance@redwood.example.com with subject line: Invoice Submission | {VendorName} | {InvoiceNumber} | PO#{PO_NUMBER}- Required fields in the body or attached PDF: Invoice number, invoice date, invoice total, Redwood PO number (if available), remit address, tax ID/EIN, and bank details for wire/ACH.- IMPORTANT: Email submissions are manually processed and can take 1–2 extra business cycles to post; for faster payment please use the portal.

3) Invoice template checklist (minimum fields)
- Vendor legal name
- Invoice number & date
- Redwood PO number (if applicable)
- Line item descriptions, quantities, unit price, line totals
- Invoice total and currency
- Remit address and payment instructions (ACH/wire details if different)
- Tax ID/EIN / VAT id (as applicable)
- Contact name/email for billing questions

4) PO & approval timing
- If a PO is required by the contract, invoices without a PO will be routed back for clarification which delays payment. If you're unsure whether a PO has been issued, please mention the contract or deal id in the invoice notes.

5) Attachments and evidence
- If an invoice references a SOW or work log, attach the supporting doc and name it: {InvoiceNumber}_support.pdf.

6) Temporary exceptions
- We can accept your first one or two invoices by email while onboarding completes. Please attach a completed Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (attached here) and the W-9 to speed things up.

I've attached our vendor onboarding form and a short vendor onboarding checklist. Once you submit those via the portal we can turn on automated PO matching for future invoices.

Best,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
